jobs.title: Bird Program Coordinator & Parrot Caretaker
jobs.description:
**Overview**

Join our dedicated team as a Bird Program Coordinator \& Parrot Caretaker, where your passion for avian welfare and expertise in bird care will shine! In this vibrant role, you will oversee the daily operations of our bird care, enrichment and educational programs, ensuring the health, safety, and happiness of our sanctuary parrots. * Coordinate, train, and support volunteers assigned to the bird areas
* Provide education about parrot species, conservation efforts, and responsible pet ownership through engaging conversation and presentations at community events
* Assist with habitat maintenance, cleaning enclosures thoroughly while adhering to animal husbandry standards
* Assists with obtaining bird photos and videos for use in social media, outreach, educational materials, and fundraising efforts

**Requirements**

* Prior experience working with animals, particularly large birds or exotic species
* Comfort interacting with large parrots
* Strong animal handling skills with an emphasis on parrots, safe restraint techniques, and behavior management
* Ability to perform cleaning duties efficiently while maintaining high standards of hygiene and safety
* Ability to safely drive a vehicle.
* Ability to safely lift up to 40lbs.
* Basic computer skills
* Excellent communication and customer service skills

Pay: $20\.00 \- $26\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 10\.0 – 30\.0 per week

Application Question(s):

* Please describe your experience working with large parrots. Which species have you personally cared for or handled?

* Why does this job appeal to you?

Experience:

* parrot: 3 years (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Social Post Production Coordinator
jobs.description:
**BuzzFeed Studios** is looking for a project\-based Social Marketing Post Production Coordinator to join our team in Los Angeles. **We’re looking for a highly organized, production\-minded coordinator who can manage multiple social marketing projects and deliverables simultaneously, working across internal teams and freelance creative partners to take projects from kickoff through final delivery.**

This role will help manage the day\-to\-day production of social marketing assets, including tracking timelines and deliverables, coordinating editors and other creative resources, routing projects between internal departments, and supporting light editing, versioning, and exports as needed.

Rate: $260\-$350/day depending on experience

Location: Los Angeles, with the ability to work in office

**Responsibilities:**

* Manage social marketing projects from kickoff through final delivery, ensuring assets stay on schedule and meet project requirements
* Build, track and maintain project timelines, asset lists, deliverables, assignments, approvals, and final delivery status across multiple concurrent campaigns
* Partner with internal Marketing, Creative, Production, Post Production, and Social teams to coordinate project handoffs and ensure teams have the assets and information needed to complete their work
* Coordinate and resource freelance video editors and other creative support based on project needs, timelines, and available budgets
* Communicate project expectations, creative briefs, technical specifications, deadlines, and feedback to freelance and internal creative teams
* Maintain clear visibility into the status of all active social marketing deliverables and proactively flag risks, delays, missing assets, or resource constraints
* Facilitate review and feedback cycles between stakeholders, editors, designers, and other creative partners
* Organize and maintain source materials, project files, creative assets, feedback, and final deliverables
* Perform light video editing, versioning, resizing, captioning, and adjustments to existing creative as needed
* Export, Quality Control, and deliver final assets according to platform and campaign specifications
* Ensure final assets are properly named, organized, archived, and accessible to relevant teams
* Support multiple campaigns and projects simultaneously, adjusting priorities as timelines and business needs change

**Requirements:**

* 1–2 years of experience in digital media, social marketing, post production, creative operations, or a related field
* Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple projects, timelines, stakeholders, and deliverables simultaneously
* Experience coordinating video editors, freelancers, or other creative resources
* Working knowledge of social and digital video production, including platform\-specific formats and deliverables
* Proficiency in Adobe Photoshop, Premiere Pro, and Media Encoder with the ability to perform light edits, versioning, exports, and Quality Control
* Familiarity with codecs, image types, resolutions, frame rates as they pertain to digital media trends
* Experience with project management and tracking tools; Airtable and Float are a plus
* Highly organized, detail\-oriented, and proactive with strong communication and problem\-solving skills
* Ability to independently guide projects from kickoff through final delivery in a fast\-paced, changing environment
* Knowledge of current social platforms, digital video trends, and entertainment marketing
* Positive, collaborative team player with a willingness to jump in where needed
* Open to working evenings, nights, and weekends as project needs require

Pay: $260\.00 \- $350\.00 per day

Ability to Commute:

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Los Angeles, CA 90038

jobs.title: Logistics Coordinator
jobs.description:
Overview

***Plan B Transportation Corp.*** *is seeking a motivated, organized, and detail\-oriented* ***Logistics Coordinator*** *to join our growing transportation team. This position plays an important role in coordinating daily freight operations, supporting drivers and carriers, communicating with customers, and ensuring shipments move efficiently from pickup to delivery.*

*The ideal candidate is a strong communicator who can multitask, solve problems quickly, and stay organized in a fast\-paced transportation environment. If you are looking to build a long\-term career in logistics with opportunities for growth and performance\-based rewards, we would love to hear from you!*

Key Responsibilities

* Coordinate daily freight shipments, pickups, deliveries, and transportation schedules
* Communicate professionally with drivers, carriers, brokers, customers, and internal teams
* Monitor shipments from pickup through delivery and provide timely status updates
* Track loads using transportation management systems, GPS, and other logistics platforms
* Assist with dispatching, load planning, route coordination, and schedule adjustments
* Identify and resolve delays, scheduling conflicts, and transportation issues
* Prepare and maintain bills of lading, rate confirmations, invoices, delivery documentation, and shipment records
* Verify shipment information, freight details, and transportation documentation for accuracy
* Maintain accurate records and assist with operational reporting and KPI tracking
* Provide responsive and professional customer service throughout the shipment process
* Support carrier coordination and help maintain strong relationships with transportation partners
* Follow company procedures, DOT requirements, and applicable transportation and safety regulations
* Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, reduce delays, and streamline logistics processes

Requirements

* Previous experience in logistics, transportation, freight coordination, dispatch, shipping, or supply chain is preferred
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to multitask and prioritize work in a fast\-paced environment
* Strong problem\-solving skills and attention to detail
* Comfortable communicating with drivers, customers, carriers, and business partners
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and Outlook
* Ability to learn and effectively use transportation and logistics software
* Professional, dependable, and customer\-focused attitude

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience with **TMS, DAT Load Board, Truckstop, GPS/fleet tracking systems**, or similar platforms
* Knowledge of freight scheduling, dispatch operations, carrier coordination, and load management
* Familiarity with DOT regulations and transportation compliance

Sikla USA, Inc. operates from our Suwanee (GA) office and is a subsidiary of the German\-Austrian Sikla Group, a manufacturer of modular steel and pipe support solutions for the industrial, manufacturing mission critical and commercial construction markets. Our team services the North American markets (USA and Canada) in providing design and engineering support to owners, GCs and trade contractors, along with a logistical service to our partners, distributors and direct customers.


**Job Description**

The Technical Project Coordinator/ Specialist acts as a key technical interface between Customer Service, Engineering, Project Management, Operations, and Warehouse Teams, with a strong focus on prefabrication (prefab) and cutting\-related projects. This role supports the full quote\-to\-order process, ensuring that customer requirements are translated into accurate technical solutions, including drawings, Bills of Materials (BOMs), and fabrication\-ready documentation. * Interpret customer inquiries, RFQs, drawings, and specifications to develop accurate technical solutions.

* Create and modify shop drawings using AutoCAD when standard Sikla drawings are not available.
* Ensure all technical documentation (drawings, BOMs, cut lists, specifications) is complete and accurate before order release.
* Translate customer requirements into fabrication\-ready packages for warehouse and production teams.
* Coordinate closely with operations and warehouse teams to support efficient execution of prefabrication and cutting jobs.
* Identify and resolve technical discrepancies, missing information, or inconsistencies across departments.
* Maintain and update project data within ERP systems to ensure data integrity.
* Contribute to process improvements, standardization, and quality assurance initiatives.
* Provide technical support and guidance to Customer Service and Sikla team members.


**Requirements \& Qualifications**
* Strong ability to read and interpret technical drawings, mechanical layouts, and construction\-related documentation.
* Hands\-on experience with AutoCAD (or similar CAD software) for drafting and shop drawings.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (BOM structuring, calculations, data validation); proficiency in Word and PowerPoint required.
* Experience working with ERP systems and structured workflows.
* Strong attention to detail and problem\-solving mindset.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and coordinate across departments.


**Education, Experience \& Soft Skills**
* Associate’s or Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering Technology, Mechanical Engineering, Drafting/Design, Industrial Technology, or a related technical field preferred.
* Minimum 3– 5 years of relevant experience in:
	+ Technical Sales Support / Inside Sales Engineering
	+ Drafting (AutoCAD)
	+ Engineering or project coordination
* Experience in construction, MEP systems, steel structures, or prefabrication environments is a strong advantage.
* Experience in quotation, costing, or project\-based customer support is preferred.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills (American English).
* High level of reliability, accountability, and ownership.
* Strong organizational and time management skills.
* Proactive and solution\-oriented approach.
* Strong team player with cross\-functional mindset.


**Job Type / Compensation / Benefits**
* Full time (40 hrs/week).
* Working hours: Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., onsite.
* Location: Suwanee 30024, and Buford 30519 (starting Q1 2027\), Georgia.
* Must be legally authorized to work in the United States.
* Competitive salary dependent on qualification and experience.
* Optional supplemental pay (performance\-based team bonus).
* Retirement Plan 401(k) with a partial company match payment.
* Health insurance plans, including medical, dental, and vision coverage.
* Paid time off (PTO) in accordance with Sikla USA policy.

new_jobs.title: Technical Project Coordinator - Modular Secondary Steel Construction (m / f / d)
new_jobs.description:
**Sikla USA, Inc.**

Sikla USA, Inc. operates from our Suwanee (GA) office and is a subsidiary of the German\-Austrian Sikla Group, a manufacturer of modular steel and pipe support solutions for the industrial, manufacturing mission critical and commercial construction markets. Our team services the North American markets (USA and Canada) in providing design and engineering support to owners, GCs and trade contractors, along with a logistical service to our partners, distributors and direct customers.


**Job Description**

The Technical Project Coordinator/ Specialist acts as a key technical interface between Customer Service, Engineering, Project Management, Operations, and Warehouse Teams, with a strong focus on prefabrication (prefab) and cutting\-related projects. This role supports the full quote\-to\-order process, ensuring that customer requirements are translated into accurate technical solutions, including drawings, Bills of Materials (BOMs), and fabrication\-ready documentation. The position plays a critical role in ensuring technical accuracy, improving operational efficiency, and enabling successful project execution. The ideal candidate combines technical drafting capabilities, commercial understanding, and operational coordination skills.


**Duties \& Responsibilities**
* Serve as the technical liaison between Customer Service, Engineering, Project Management, and Operations for all prefab and cutting\-related customer orders.
* Interpret customer inquiries, RFQs, drawings, and specifications to develop accurate technical solutions.
* Support the quotation and costing process by creating and validating Bills of Materials (BOMs).
* Create and modify shop drawings using AutoCAD when standard Sikla drawings are not available.
* Ensure all technical documentation (drawings, BOMs, cut lists, specifications) is complete and accurate before order release.
* Translate customer requirements into fabrication\-ready packages for warehouse and production teams.
* Coordinate closely with operations and warehouse teams to support efficient execution of prefabrication and cutting jobs.
* Identify and resolve technical discrepancies, missing information, or inconsistencies across departments.
* Maintain and update project data within ERP systems to ensure data integrity.
* Contribute to process improvements, standardization, and quality assurance initiatives.
* Provide technical support and guidance to Customer Service and Sikla team members.


**Requirements \& Qualifications**
* Strong ability to read and interpret technical drawings, mechanical layouts, and construction\-related documentation.
* Hands\-on experience with AutoCAD (or similar CAD software) for drafting and shop drawings.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (BOM structuring, calculations, data validation); proficiency in Word and PowerPoint required.
* Experience working with ERP systems and structured workflows.
* Strong attention to detail and problem\-solving mindset.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and coordinate across departments.


**Education, Experience \& Soft Skills**
* Associate’s or Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering Technology, Mechanical Engineering, Drafting/Design, Industrial Technology, or a related technical field preferred.
* Minimum 3– 5 years of relevant experience in:
	+ Technical Sales Support / Inside Sales Engineering
	+ Drafting (AutoCAD)
	+ Engineering or project coordination
* Experience in construction, MEP systems, steel structures, or prefabrication environments is a strong advantage.
* Experience in quotation, costing, or project\-based customer support is preferred.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills (American English).
* High level of reliability, accountability, and ownership.
* Strong organizational and time management skills.
* Proactive and solution\-oriented approach.
* Strong team player with cross\-functional mindset.


**Job Type / Compensation / Benefits**
* Full time (40 hrs/week).
* Working hours: Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., onsite.
* Location: Suwanee 30024, and Buford 30519 (starting Q1 2027\), Georgia.
* Must be legally authorized to work in the United States.
* Competitive salary dependent on qualification and experience.
* Optional supplemental pay (performance\-based team bonus).
* Retirement Plan 401(k) with a partial company match payment.
* Health insurance plans, including medical, dental, and vision coverage.
* Paid time off (PTO) in accordance with Sikla USA policy.
